circuits.description: One row per published circuit (overhead line or cable) at one voltage class. Electrical values come from the DNO Long Term Development Statements (LTDS Table 1) as harmonised in the GDA cable lake; 275kV and 400kV rows are SSEN transmission GIS circuits that carry route length but no published impedance. Sentinel values (9999) in the source are nulled here and recorded in quality_flags.

fields.name: profile_id
fields.description: Stable profile identifier: 'cable-' plus the first 16 hex characters of the SHA-256 of source_key.

fields.name: profile_rev
fields.description: Revision of this profile. It stays the same while the profile's content is unchanged and goes up by one when any value changes, so profile_id@profile_rev always means one fixed set of values.
fields.source: derived: previous build's revision and content_sha256

fields.name: content_sha256
fields.description: SHA-256 of the profile's values (every field except profile_rev, content_sha256 and last_updated_utc, floats by their exact bits). Used to decide when profile_rev goes up.

fields.name: source_dataset
fields.description: Lake dataset the row was built from.

fields.name: source_key
fields.description: The cable lake's cable_id for this circuit.

fields.name: evidence_source
fields.description: The original published file the cable lake read this circuit from.

fields.name: last_updated_utc
fields.description: Profiles last updated: the date these profiles were brought up to.

fields.name: operator
fields.description: Network operator group (ukpn, npg, nged, spen, ssen).

fields.name: licence
fields.description: Licence area within the operator group (for example EPN, SPM, NPGY).

fields.name: voltage_kv
fields.description: Nominal voltage of the circuit. A published circuit runs at one voltage, so this is the voltage at both ends; voltage changes happen at transformers (see the Transformers family).

fields.name: voltage_class
fields.description: Profiles folder for the voltage (6.6kv, 11kv, 33kv, 66kv, 132kv, 275kv, 400kv).
fields.source: derived: voltage_kv mapped to GB voltage classes

fields.name: row_kind
fields.description: ltds_circuit (published impedance) or gis_circuit (route geometry and length only, no published impedance).

fields.name: circuit_name
fields.description: Circuit name as published.

fields.name: circuit_code
fields.description: Circuit code as published.

fields.name: from_node
fields.description: Node (substation busbar) at the sending end, as published.

fields.name: to_node
fields.description: Node (substation busbar) at the receiving end, as published.

fields.name: status
fields.description: Circuit state as published (energised or out).

fields.name: construction
fields.description: overhead, underground or unknown.

fields.name: conductor_type
fields.description: Conductor or cable type where published (mostly blank in LTDS).

fields.name: length_km
fields.description: Circuit length used for per-km values: the LTDS-published length for LTDS circuits, the computed route length for GIS circuits.

fields.name: length_km_published
fields.description: Length as published in the LTDS.

fields.name: length_km_route
fields.description: Length computed from the GIS route geometry (geodesic). For NPG LTDS circuits this covers the overhead portion only.

fields.name: r_ohm
fields.description: Positive-sequence series resistance of the whole circuit, harmonised to ohms by the cable lake.

fields.name: x_ohm
fields.description: Positive-sequence series reactance of the whole circuit, harmonised to ohms.

fields.name: b_us
fields.description: Total shunt susceptance of the whole circuit in microsiemens: (b_pct_100mva / 100) x 100 MVA / voltage_kv squared, x 1e6.

fields.name: r0_ohm
fields.description: Zero-sequence series resistance of the whole circuit in ohms, from reported_r0 on reported_impedance_base by the same rule that gives r_ohm (percent or per unit on 100 MVA x kV squared / 100; ohmic values as published). Published by some operators only.

fields.name: x0_ohm
fields.description: Zero-sequence series reactance of the whole circuit in ohms, converted as r0_ohm.

fields.name: r_pct_100mva
fields.description: Series resistance in percent on a 100 MVA base.

fields.name: x_pct_100mva
fields.description: Series reactance in percent on a 100 MVA base.

fields.name: b_pct_100mva
fields.description: Shunt susceptance in percent on a 100 MVA base.

fields.name: r_ohm_per_km
fields.description: r_ohm / length_km, set only when both are valid and the length is above zero.

fields.name: x_ohm_per_km
fields.description: x_ohm / length_km, set only when both are valid and the length is above zero.

fields.name: b_us_per_km
fields.description: b_us / length_km, set only when both are valid and the length is above zero.

fields.name: x_over_r
fields.description: X/R ratio, set only when r_ohm is above zero.

fields.name: reported_impedance_base
fields.description: The base the operator published its impedance on: percent_on_100mva, pu_on_100mva or ohmic_referred.

fields.name: reported_r1
fields.description: Positive-sequence resistance exactly as reported, on reported_impedance_base (no conversion).

fields.name: reported_x1
fields.description: Positive-sequence reactance exactly as reported, on reported_impedance_base.

fields.name: reported_b1
fields.description: Positive-sequence susceptance exactly as reported, on reported_impedance_base.

fields.name: reported_r0
fields.description: Zero-sequence resistance exactly as reported, on reported_impedance_base (published by some operators only).

fields.name: reported_x0
fields.description: Zero-sequence reactance exactly as reported, on reported_impedance_base.

fields.name: rating_winter_mva
fields.description: Winter thermal rating as published.

fields.name: rating_summer_mva
fields.description: Summer thermal rating as published.

fields.name: rating_mva
fields.description: Rating the cable lake uses as the circuit's main rating (the winter rating where published).

fields.name: rate_a_mva
fields.description: GridSim Rate A (normal, continuous): the winter continuous rating where published.

fields.name: rate_a_basis
fields.description: What Rate A is: the season or condition the published rating applies to.

fields.name: rate_b_mva
fields.description: [VERIFY] GridSim Rate B (short-term). Not published for these assets, so null; GridSim applies its own documented default.

fields.name: rate_b_basis
fields.description: [VERIFY] What Rate B is (null while Rate B is not published).

fields.name: rate_c_mva
fields.description: [VERIFY] GridSim Rate C (emergency): not published for circuits in LTDS, so null.

fields.name: rate_c_basis
fields.description: [VERIFY] What Rate C is (null while Rate C is not published).

fields.name: geometry_wkt
fields.description: Route geometry (WGS84 WKT) where the cable lake holds it.

fields.name: named_operator
fields.description: [VERIFY] Operator or owner of the asset, from Cables/names.csv (named by hand, not published). Null where not named.

fields.name: named_site
fields.description: [VERIFY] Site name, from Cables/names.csv. Null where not named.

fields.name: named_address
fields.description: [VERIFY] Site address, from Cables/names.csv. Null where not named.

fields.name: named_by
fields.description: [VERIFY] Who named the asset and when, from Cables/names.csv.

fields.name: quality_flags
fields.description: Semicolon list of data issues found while building the row (for example sentinel_9999_impedance, zero_impedance, no_length, sentinel_9999_rating). Empty when none.

types.description: Cable and line archetypes per voltage class: circuits grouped by construction and conductor type, with the spread of per-km impedance, rating and length. Use these to pick a typical cable for a synthetic network. Built from ltds_circuit rows only, with no quality flags.
